author: yavapai news
title: Republican Governors Association congratulates Gregg Hull on New Mexico primary win
text:
June 3, the Republican Governors Association released a statement congratulating Gregg Hull on his victory in the New Mexico Republican gubernatorial primary.
The statement, issued from Washington, D.C., included remarks from RGA Chair Governor Greg Gianforte. “Congratulations to Gregg Hull on his primary victory. As Mayor of Rio Rancho, Hull has helped create good-paying jobs, improved infrastructure, and cracked down on crime. That’s exactly what he will do as governor,” according to Gianforte.
Gianforte also commented on Deb Haaland, saying, “Deb Haaland turned her back on New Mexico to push Biden’s failed policies and the Green New Scam. New Mexico deserves a leader, not a career politician who forgot where she came from.”
The Republican Governors Association is a national organization that supports Republican gubernatorial candidates and provides resources for state-level campaigns. The group maintains a presence on social media platforms and its official website, according to the Republican Governors Association .
The RGA statement was distributed through its press office and authorized by the organization.
